documents.title: Annual report extract
documents.text:
Annual report extract: Ivarsen Software (fictional, authored test material).
For Ivarsen GmbH, operating expenses in FY2024 was $174.9m (reported basis). Gross debt at Ivarsen Software stood at roughly $170m in FY2025 (reported basis). Ivarsen Software had receivables in arrears of 1.8% with effect from 1 Jan 2025. For Ivarsen Software, cash on balance sheet in FY2024 was $70.2m (reported basis). The change of control definition for Ivarsen Software is understood as follows: triggered by any transfer of more than 30% of economic interest. As to Ivarsen Software, the security package is: unsecured, ranking pari passu with trade creditors.

documents.title: Quarterly lender update
documents.text:
Quarterly lender update: Ivarsen Software (fictional, authored test material).
For Ivarsen Oy, operating expenses in FY2024 was $212.2m (reported basis). Free cash flow at Ivarsen Software stood at $18.3m in FY2025 (reported basis). Ivarsen Software had senior leverage of 3.89x in FY2025 (pro forma (including the planned acquisition) basis). For Ivarsen Software, cash on balance sheet was $52.6m (reported basis). The change of control definition for Ivarsen Software is understood as follows: triggered when the sponsor holds less than 50% of voting shares.

documents.title: Independent business review
documents.text:
Independent business review: Ivarsen Software (fictional, authored test material).
For Ivarsen Software, gross debt in FY2025 was $173.9m (reported basis). Receivables in arrears at Ivarsen Software stood at 1.6% with effect from 1 Jul 2025. Ivarsen Software had free cash flow of $15.6m in FY2025 (reported basis). For Ivarsen Software, senior leverage in FY2025 was 5.41x (reported basis). As to Ivarsen Software, the security package is: first-lien security over all material subsidiaries.
